# Cyberpunk Argentina color-mode review

Captured from the local static website with headless Chromium on 2026-10-11.
The shared selector uses the Hornero signal palette to distinguish System,
Light and Dark while keeping the Buenos Aires night artwork consistent.

- `homepage-dark.png` — 1440×1000, Dark mode on the home page.
- `themes-light.png` — 1440×1000, Light mode on the Themes page.
- `homepage-mobile.png` — 390×844, System mode on the home page.

These show the website, not HorneroOS desktop captures. Product media retains
its own capture provenance in the rendered pages.
